module.purpose: Parses serialized Redux DevTools state, selecting the appropriate jsan reviver and unpacking optional payload and preloaded-state envelopes.
module.summary: This utility converts a serialized state string into the lifted Redux DevTools state format. It supports default jsan parsing, Immutable.js-aware revival, custom revivers, and nested payload envelopes containing optional preloaded state. Empty input produces no result, while malformed serialized input propagates the parser error.
module.businessContext: Redux DevTools needs to import persisted or transferred state snapshots into its lifted-state model. Failure prevents state restoration, debugging session loading, or replay initialization.
classes: State (~L7-11): Represents lifted Redux DevTools state and optional committed state
functions: importState (~L13-70): Parses serialized state and unwraps optional payload envelopes

detail.name: importState
detail.signature: export function importState(state: string, { serialize, }: { serialize?: { immutable?: typeof Immutable; refs?: (new (data: any) => unknown)[] | null; reviver?: (key: string, value: unknown) => unknown; }; })

parameters.name: serialize
parameters.type: { immutable?: typeof Immutable; refs?: (new (data: any) => unknown)[] | null; reviver?: (key: string, value: unknown) => unknown; }

preconditions: When serialize.immutable is provided, it is a compatible Immutable implementation.
When serialize.refs is provided, each entry is a constructible reference type accepted by the Immutable-aware deserializer.
postconditions: For a falsy state string, returns undefined without parsing.
For a non-empty state string without a payload wrapper, parses the state and returns it as nextLiftedState with no preloadedState.
For a non-empty state string with a payload wrapper, parses payload as nextLiftedState and parses preloadedState when the wrapper contains one.
Uses the configured deserialization strategy when serialize.immutable or serialize.reviver is supplied.
invariants: The selected parser is used consistently for the outer state and any nested payload or preloadedState values.
The returned nextLiftedState is the parsed state value, or the parsed payload when the outer value contains a payload.
edgeCases: An empty string or other falsy state returns undefined.
A non-empty serialized value without payload is parsed directly as nextLiftedState.
A serialized wrapper with payload parses payload as nextLiftedState.
A serialized wrapper with both payload and preloadedState parses both independently.
Malformed serialized input or a reviver/parser failure propagates the underlying parsing error.

raises: Underlying jsan.parse or configured reviver/deserializer errors
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Falsy state returns undefined; non-falsy malformed serialized input propagates the parser error.
